title: Very lightweight!
text: Very lightweight!. Surprisingly thin and very lightweight. I’ve used knock boxes before in coffee shops I’ve worked in. They are much heavier gauge than this. Also, the rim is sharp enough to cut you. This will work if you have no other options, but if you do, I’d look elsewhere for a sturdier product.

product_metadata.title: Coffee Knock Box, Stainless Steel Espresso Dump Bin, Durable Sturdy Knock Box for Coffee Ground, 6.93 * 6.38 * 5.9 Inch
features: [Durable and Sturdy] Made of Heavy-duty stainless steel, the knock box is made for hard knocks. It can hold a medium volume of pucks with its size and can be used on top of or recessed into a counter.

[Easy to Use] A lip around the edge of the box allows you to sink the box into a counter top or espresso bar. Keep your counter area clean with this durable stainless steel knock box for dispensing all your spent espresso shots.
[Widely Used] Widely used at home, kitchen, cafe shop, canteen, western restaurants, bars and more. Affordable and reliable product for you.
